_doc: Oathwild classes = MASTERIES (owner 2026-11-23: Titan Quest masteries + Pathfinder class levels; up to 30 classes consolidated from Farhold/Thousandvale/Emberveil — see docs/CLASSES.md for what was kept and merged). Every character level-up picks a class (js/rules/levels.js). A class's level is its mastery bar: it opens deeper nodes (`level`), gives the class's growth (health, mana, attributes) and points to spend ONLY in that class (`rules.pointsPerLevel`). A node is a spell (rank 1-3, from data/spells.json), a passive (ranks, `mods` per rank, read by js/rules/sheet.js), a proficiency (`grants`, read by js/rules/proficiency.js) or a MODIFIER (`on` = a spell node of this class; changes how that spell works, needs that spell at `needsRank`). `free` nodes come with the class level (rank 1, no point). At `rules.pathLevel` you choose ONE path per class (`paths`); a node with `path` is only for that path. Nodes sharing a `choice` group exclude each other (the capstones). Rank r of a node needs class level `level + rankGap*(r-1)`. Spells you learn from a class get +`classPowerPerLevel` per class level above 1 of that class (depth pays). No limit on how many classes a character takes and no spreading penalty (owner 2026-11-23: 'No guard at all'). `tier`: base (open at creation), advanced (unlocked, full 10-level tree) or specialty (NWN2-style prestige class: unlocked by requirements, a short tree to `rules.specialtyMaxLevel`, capstone at its last level, no paths). `round: 2` = reachable only after round 1's level-10 cap (listed so the tree exists).

rules._starterDoc: `starter` on a base class: Emberveil base keys a new character of that class starts wearing (normal, medium quality, item level 1).
rules._dualDoc: `dualWield: true` on a class: its characters may hold a second one-handed weapon in the off hand (game-standards §5b — which classes may is data). The Two-Weapon Fighting talent grants it to anyone. The off-hand weapon strikes right after each main-hand swing for Farhold's OFFHAND_DAMAGE share of its own dice (js/rules/combat.js).

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.blurb: Steel, nerve and a shield or a great blade. The toughest body in the party.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.blurb: Shield first: taunts, stuns and blocks that hold the line.

reaver.name: Reaver
reaver.blurb: Two hands on the hilt: spinning cuts and huge single blows.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.blurb: Long shots, quick feet and traps laid where the enemy will walk.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.blurb: One arrow, one body: long draws, piercing shots, deadly criticals.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.blurb: Snares, caltrops and arrow storms that own the ground.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.blurb: Strikes from where you aren't looking, poison on every edge.

cutthroat.name: Cutthroat
cutthroat.blurb: Gutting strikes and sudden stuns for one target at a time.

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.blurb: Darts and clouds that keep killing after you leave.

mage.name: Mage
mage.blurb: Shards of ice and raw arcane force. Fragile, and terrifying from range.

frost.name: Frost
frost.blurb: Slow, freeze and shatter: control the fight from afar.

arcane.name: Arcane
arcane.blurb: Wild force and mana-rending blasts: the biggest raw numbers.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.role: Healer of the light and dusk
cleric.blurb: Keeps the party standing, and burns what threatens it with light or shadow.

dawn.name: Dawn
dawn.blurb: The healer: hallowed ground, mending light, the fallen raised.

dusk.name: Dusk
dusk.blurb: The shadow priest: lances of shadow that heal you as they hurt.

druid.name: Druid
druid.blurb: Becomes the wolf and the bear, calls the pack, or speaks with root and storm — choose one way and go deep.

shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
shapeshifter.blurb: Become a real wolf, then a real bear; your attacks become theirs.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.blurb: Call wolves and a great bear to fight beside you.

caster.name: Caster
caster.blurb: Roots, thorns and moonlight from a distance.

bard.name: Bard
bard.blurb: Lifts the party with songs, breaks the enemy with discord, or lulls them to sleep.

valour.name: Valour
valour.blurb: Battle songs and a charge that carries the party with you.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.blurb: Plants spirit posts that heal, calls a spirit bear, or brings the storm down.

spirit.name: Spirit
spirit.blurb: Spirit posts and a spirit bear that guard the party.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.blurb: Sworn steel and holy light. The class that opens plate armour.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.blurb: Guards the party: barriers, taunts and blessed earth.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.blurb: Hunts the dark: holy blows and a descent from the sky.

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade.blurb: A blade in one hand and a spell in the other — every strike carries magic.

runeblade.name: Runeblade
runeblade.blurb: Runes that stack on the enemy and an anvil that falls on them.

riftblade.name: Riftblade
riftblade.blurb: Steps through the air and strikes from range with an arcane edge.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.blurb: Bargained power: hexes that rot, a bound fiend, and gates you pay for in blood.

fiendbound.name: Fiendbound
fiendbound.blurb: A bound fiend at your side, growing stronger.

hexer.name: Hexer
hexer.blurb: Hexes and rifts that spread ruin.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.blurb: Bare hands, a staff and a still mind. Fast, hard to hit, no armour needed.

open_hand.name: Open Hand
open_hand.blurb: Palm strikes that knock down and a fist that shakes the ground.

still_mind.name: Still Mind
still_mind.blurb: Breathe, heal, and spin the staff nine times.

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
pyromancer.blurb: Everything burns. Lines of fire, falling stones and flashovers.

cinder.name: Cinder
cinder.blurb: Close and fast: breath of fire and a burning stride.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.blurb: Bolts that fork from foe to foe and a storm you walk inside.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.blurb: The eye of the storm over a whole field.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.blurb: Step as lightning and chain it further.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.blurb: Raises the dead to fight for you, or rots the living where they stand.

witch_hunter.name: Witch Hunter
witch_hunter.blurb: Silver, iron nets and holy writs for the things that cast and the things that crawl out of rifts.

inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
inquisitor.blurb: Nets, silence and circles where no spell can be cast.

slayer.name: Slayer
slayer.blurb: Brand bolts and chain hooks that drag the prey in.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.blurb: A specialty class: flourishes, lunges and a showman's flurry for a light blade.

shadowdancer.name: Shadowdancer
shadowdancer.blurb: A specialty class: steps through shadow and leaves shades of itself behind.

spellfletcher.name: Spellfletcher
spellfletcher.blurb: A specialty class: every arrow carries a spell — frost, flame or raw force.

bladesworn.name: Bladesworn
bladesworn.blurb: A specialty class: years with one weapon — its every swing perfected.

wrathborn.name: Wrathborn
wrathborn.blurb: A specialty class: fury that shrugs off wounds and swings wider the more it bleeds.

gravecutter.name: Gravecutter
gravecutter.blurb: A specialty class: contracts, marks and the one cut that ends it. Found through a contract in the wilds.

dragon_knight.name: Dragon Knight
dragon_knight.blurb: Fire-tempered steel, scales and a wyrm's breath. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

scaled.name: Scaled
scaled.blurb: Scales and temper: the dragon's hide.

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
chronomancer.blurb: Hurries friends, slows foes, and stops the clock. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.blurb: Sees the blow before it lands. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

doom.name: Doom
doom.blurb: Prophecies that fall on the enemy.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.blurb: Sentries, grenades and lucky finds from every pocket. (Opens with the Smithing bench.)

starcaller.name: Starcaller
starcaller.blurb: Star darts, falling stars and a blade of starlight. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

skyward.name: Skyward
skyward.blurb: Stars that fall where you point.

starblade.name: Starblade
starblade.blurb: A blade of starlight up close.
